---
title: "From chat to agent"
---

A chat returns text. An agent can inspect files, use tools, make changes, run checks, and respond to the results. The model proposes actions. The harness runs the loop and controls its boundaries.

## The loop

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Goal and constraints] --> B[Model proposes plan]
  B --> C[Harness selects a tool]
  C --> D[Approval or policy check]
  D --> E[Read, edit, or run]
  E --> F[Observed result]
  F --> B
  F --> G[Human reviews artefact]
```

Do not trust a confident answer on its own. Check the file, diff, command output, or test.

CLI agents expose the loop in a terminal. GUI agents add visual context, buttons, and approval controls. Their defaults, permissions, and extensions differ, so compare what they do. Do not assume a GUI is safer or a CLI is more autonomous.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try it now (5 minutes)

Ask an agent: "List the files you would inspect for this task. Do not read or edit anything." Then ask which statements are observations and which are guesses.
:::
